title: Close cut-in followed by braking (UN R157 / NHTSA C2)
originalIntent: PRE-REGISTERED before running or tuning this template. An adjacent-lane vehicle cuts in close ahead of the ego and then brakes. The lane change must COMPLETE (not be rejected or aborted), the braking must follow it, and the ego must be brought into a genuine but avoidable rear-end near-miss with no contact. Bands from docs/research/interactions-and-edge-cases.md (TTC critical band 1.2-2.5 s, post-merge headway 0.6-4 s) and UN R157 cut-in grids. NOT derived from observed results.
